As you progress through the game, you'll encounter an array of obstacles, including goblins, traps, and collapsing platforms. The game's unique concept revolves around the use of a simple click-based mechanic, where each click moves your character one space forward.

One of the standout features of Bridge of Doom is its endless gameplay mode. With a constant stream of obstacles and enemies, the game provides an almost endless challenge that will keep you coming back for more. But don't worry, you won't be alone on your journey.
